is valid; contagion is local, where a well-mixed surrogate over-predicts the peak and clustering,
not the degree tail, drives the break.

Figure 8:AgentSociety in the local, long-memory cell.Scalar mean-field error grows under
densification and floors at fixed degree; a pair-plus-memory closure repairs it, and removing the
conviction memory collapses the break.

Figure 9:Closure versus autodiff.A gradient-free degree-aware closure recovers the
mortality curve and the planted parameters roughly10310^{3}times faster than the differentiable
million-agent model, for the aggregate observable.
